question: A rectangular parallelepiped has dimensions 4 cm × 3 cm × 2 cm. Find its total surface area.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cuboid = 2 × (Sum of product of adjacent sides)

TSA = 2 × (4 × 3 + 3 × 2 + 2 × 4)

TSA = 2 × (12 + 6 + 8) = 2 × 26 = 52 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 52 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 4 cm

Breadth (b) = 3 cm

Height (h) = 2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a rectangular parallelepiped (cuboid) = 2(lb + bh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abdc457ba98edd93d2d93d2ef465b473b25322e9aed5de0fdd285d4cad31badb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ TSA = 2 × (4 × 3 + 3 × 2 + 2 × 4)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (12 + 6 + 8)

⇒ TSA = 2 × 26

⇒ TSA = 52 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 52 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Volume = l × b × h cubic units.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four side faces (excluding top and bottom) is LSA = 2h(l + b) sq. units.

Diagonal of Cuboid

The length of the longest rod that can be placed inside is Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²) units.</p
